title: Bram and the Group Chat
author: C. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Elodie Halloran, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
